current_point.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，采用领导-工作者模式，由领导节点进行图划分，工作节点基于图摘要进行小批量训练，并通过注意力层返回结果，实现分布式训练加速。
current_point.claim_en: Propose a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm DSGNN based on graph summarization, adopting a leader-worker mode where the leader partitions the graph, workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization, and results are returned through an attention layer, accelerating distributed training.
source_locations: 摘要视图：DSGNN 模型采用“领导——工作者”工作模式...
作者贡献段2：提出了一种新的基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络训练框架，称为DSGNN...
technical_features: 采用“领导——工作者”工作模式
领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分并分配子图
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回给领导节点
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: The leader partitions the original graph using a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation and assigns subgraphs
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology
Training results are returned to the leader through an attention layer
The leader aggregates results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes
